title: OpenBrick3D process profile
description: What a manufacturing process can resolve (profiles/process/*.json, .obprofile.json). Read by openbrick-print as ProcessProfile with camelCase fields; see docs/plan/05 section 3. Validator thresholds come from these values. Schema 1.1 adds the optional recommendedTubeWallMm and maxRemovedAreaPct to 1.0; a 1.0 or 1.1 document may use only the fields named here ($defs/knownFields), and a 1.0 document none added since 1.0 ($defs/since1_1).

experimental.description: Experimental processes may break the minFeature = 2 x lineWidth rule and carry no clutch data yet.

layerHeightMm.description: Supported layer heights, finest first or in any order.

wallQuantiseMm.description: Walls are rounded to multiples of this (usually the line width).

minFeatureMm.description: Smallest printable stroke or detail; rule FEATURE.MIN and the morphological opening of artwork use it.

minFeatureRule.description: Human-readable derivation of minFeatureMm, for example 2 x lineWidthMm. Not read by openbrick-print yet.

minTubeWallMm.description: Thinnest underside tube wall after fit offsets (rule TUBE.WALL).

recommendedTubeWallMm.description: Since 1.1. Tube walls from minTubeWallMm up to this value print but get a TUBE.WALL warning (docs/plan/05 section 5: minTubeWallMm 0.7, warning below 0.8). Optional: without it there is no warning band. Should be at least minTubeWallMm.

maxRemovedAreaPct.description: Since 1.1. Share of the artwork area, in percent, the morphological opening at minFeatureMm may remove before rule FEATURE.MIN reports it: a blocker on fit-critical artwork, a warning otherwise (docs/plan/05 section 5: report the removed area percent; docs/plan/06 section 5). Rule FEATURE.MIN reports more than this; exactly this much passes. The opening also rounds convex corners (0.11 % of a 13.2 mm square at 0.8 mm), so keep it above that. Optional: without it the removed area is never a trigger.

minCavityDepthMm.description: Cavity depth a deboss must leave so studs below still enter (rule CAVITY.DEPTH).

maxOverhangDeg.description: Steepest printable overhang in degrees from vertical.

firstLayerChamferMm.description: Bottom-edge chamfer against elephant's foot; 0 for processes without it.

wallRoofFilletMm.description: Inner wall-to-roof fillet radius by body kind (the body.* ops).

horizontalHoleStrategy.description: How horizontal Technic holes are compensated (docs/plan/05 section 6).

horizontalHoleStrategies.description: Strategies this process can use; horizontalHoleStrategy is the default. Not read by openbrick-print yet.

tessellation.description: Mesh resolution defaults for this process. openbrick-print reads it (ProcessProfile::tessellation); the part evaluator uses studSegments for studs, tubes and pins, and minEdgeMm is not used yet.

studSegments.description: Segments per full circle of a stud.

notes.description: Free text. Not read by openbrick-print yet.

since1_1.description: The fields added in schema 1.1 (recommendedTubeWallMm and maxRemovedAreaPct). A document that uses one declares 1.1 or later in its pragma (schemas/README.md, Versioning), so a tool that only has the 1.0 schema reads it leniently; a 1.0 document that uses one is an error at that field.

knownFields.description: The fields schema 1.1 names (those of 1.0 plus recommendedTubeWallMm and maxRemovedAreaPct), object by object; true means the value is checked by the main schema. Applied only to 1.0 and 1.1 documents (see atThisMinor), where any other field is an error: serde would drop it silently, so a misspelt optional field would change nothing. Objects not listed here are open on purpose. cargo xtask data checks that these lists match the properties the schema declares.

atThisMinor.description: Matches a document whose pragma names a minor version this schema knows, 1.0 or 1.1 (or a patch of either). Such a document may use only the fields this schema names ($defs/knownFields). A document of a later 1.x minor may carry fields added since; this schema checks the fields it knows and ignores the rest, so older tools can still read newer minors (docs/plan/08 section 9). Unlike the other shared definitions this one follows the schema's own minor version (cargo xtask data checks it against $id).

positiveMm.description: A length in millimetres greater than zero.

nonNegativeMm.description: A length in millimetres, zero or more.

holeStrategy.description: polyhole: polygon with corrected circumradius; ellipse: slightly taller hole; teardrop: pointed ceiling, no overhang.

pragma.description: Schema version pragma: major 1 and a minor, optionally a patch (docs/plan/08 sections 1 and 9). Every 1.x is accepted: readers ignore fields from minors newer than they know, and this schema checks only the fields it names in documents newer than 1.0 (see atThisMinor).

spdx.description: An SPDX licence id, or a simple AND, OR or WITH expression of ids (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

credit.description: Who made the document. Keeping it is a community norm, not a legal condition (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

provenance.description: Where the data came from, so attribution travels with it through conversion, export and printing (LICENSE-POLICY.md, docs/plan/06 section 2).

source.description: original, or the upstream file or project the data derives from.

profileId.description: A profile id: lower-case words joined by hyphens, where a word may hold dots, as in fdm-0.4 or resin-msla (docs/plan/05 section 3).
